title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Disease-Free Survival in Breast Cancer Incorporating Clinical and Treatment Information: Retrospective Cohort Study With External Validation.
summary: An XGBoost accelerated-failure-time model combined clinical, pathological and treatment information to predict postoperative disease-free survival. It was developed on 861 patients, internally validated on 370 patients and externally evaluated on 304 TCGA patients; this retrospective validation does not establish clinical benefit.
ai_technology: XGBoost accelerated failure-time model; SHAP interpretation
organization: The Affiliated People’s Hospital of Jiangsu University; Shantou University Medical College

evidence.tested: The reported 5-year AUC was 0.840 in training, 0.822 in internal validation and 0.762 in the TCGA external cohort; external concordance index was 0.750.
evidence.unknown: Both cohorts were retrospective; external validation does not establish prospective clinical utility or benefit.
evidence.ai_role: XGBoost accelerated failure-time model; SHAP interpretation

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
